scopes.why: Read the current Auth0 session via the SPA client (isAuthenticated/getIdTokenClaims) to expose the signed-in user via useAuth().
Sign the user out (client.logout) when the app calls useAuth().signOut(), letting Auth0's own SDK perform its default post-logout redirect.
Verify a request's Auth0 access token server-side by calling Auth0's own public GET {domain}/userinfo endpoint, applying fail-closed handling before any protected server route trusts the caller.
